business_problem: ScatterKings needed a data platform that could keep iGaming sessions responsive at sub-100 millisecond speeds while allowing a small team to modernize a complex stack without depending on specialist database engineers.
solution_summary: ScatterKings rebuilt its iGaming platform on MongoDB Atlas so it could deliver high-performance game services and modernize away from aging technology used elsewhere in the industry. The most demanding component is the Remote Gaming System that coordinates player actions, customer-server interactions, and financial bookkeeping during time-critical gameplay, so even a few milliseconds of latency can create major operational and revenue risk. Atlas became the database under that roughly 500,000-line application because it combined fast document performance, easy scaling, and lower operational overhead than the relational stack the founders had used previously. The platform now supports live migrations between countries, quick capacity expansion, and rapid iteration by developers who can change application behavior without long database projects. This gives ScatterKings a more agile way to ship premium games and enter new markets while preserving real-time performance under heavy load.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores and serves the real-time gaming data behind ScatterKings' Remote Gaming System and production workloads.

data_flow: Player requests flow into ScatterKings' Remote Gaming System, the application exchanges validation and bookkeeping data with customer servers, MongoDB Atlas persists the live game state and related operational records, and the platform returns subsecond responses to keep gameplay continuous.
business_outcome: ScatterKings cut development schedules from months to weeks, improved migration and scaling speed, and gained the confidence to expand its gaming business without repeated infrastructure redesign.
